factoryTitle: Why Buy From a Factory, Not a Trader
factoryIntro: A lot of "Moroccan suppliers" online are resellers. There's nothing wrong with that, but it matters when something goes wrong. We press argan oil and make black soap in Marrakech; we fill, label, check and ship other Moroccan products from the same facility. Buying direct from us means:

factoryPoints.title: Traceability
factoryPoints.desc: each batch can be traced back through our production records.

factoryPoints.title: Consistency
factoryPoints.desc: repeat orders come from the same process, not from whoever had stock that week.

factoryTip: Ask any supplier - including us - for a video call inside the facility. It's the quickest way to know who you're dealing with.
orderIntro: A simple, transparent process from your first inquiry to delivery.

docsIntro: International buyers need paperwork as much as product. Depending on the product and the order, we provide:

docItems.title: Product specification sheets and INCI lists
docItems.description: Clear formulas and ingredient lists for your QC, labeling, and market registration.

docItems.title: Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS/SDS)
docItems.description: Safety and handling information for storage, transport, and regulatory compliance.

docItems.title: Certificate of origin and export documents
docItems.description: Customs-ready paperwork for international shipments from our Marrakech facility.

docItems.title: Certificate of Analysis (COA) per batch on request
docItems.description: Batch test results on request so you can trace quality back to production.

docItems.title: Pro-forma invoice, packing list, and export invoice
docItems.description: Commercial documents prepared for your bank, forwarder, and customs clearance.

shippingBody: We ship samples by express courier and orders by air or sea freight to Europe, North America, the Gulf and beyond. We prepare the export documents; your forwarder or ours handles transport to your door.
